title: Scanned slide pptx 001
notes: scanned-slide emulation on the docx scanned-ocr pattern: the same synthetic raster generator (_sc_scan_png imported from the docx builder — off-white paper gray, gray pseudo-text word bars, seeded per-pixel noise from the fixture-seeded ctx.rng) is embedded via add_picture stretched to the FULL slide (slide_width x slide_height), with one caption text box near the bottom. The raster has NO text layer (bars, not glyphs), so there is no OCR truth inside the picture: reference_text is the caption ONLY — the honest near-None case.
